defs.def: the ability to put effort and enthusiasm into an activity, work, etc. 精力；活力；干劲

ex.s: Toby was using up his energy by running back and forth in the backyard and giving the kids plenty of room.
ex.t: 托比通过在后院来回奔跑来发泄精力，也给孩子们留出了充足的活动空间。

ex.s: Good habits save time, energy and sometimes your life.
ex.t: 好习惯节省时间、精力，有时还能救命。

ex.s: I had put so much time and emotional energy into applying, and I thought the rejection meant the end of the road for my science career.
ex.t: 我在申请上投入了那么多时间和情感精力，我以为那封拒信意味着我的科学事业走到了尽头。

ex.s: Things quickly got very intense due to the huge amount of energy required to look after them.
ex.t: 由于照顾它们需要耗费巨大的精力，一切很快就变得十分紧张忙碌。

ex.s: They can be transformed into energy.
ex.t: 它们净化空气。

ex.s: Waste one's energy taking risks．
ex.t: B．年龄不是实现目标的障碍

ex.s: Running is cheap,easy and it’s always   69  (energy).
ex.t: 跑步既便宜又容易，而且总是很____69____（充满活力）。

ex.s: Producing them requires more energy.
ex.t: 塑料、纸张还是两者都不是

ex.s: Many people enjoy herbal tea because it can have a positive effect on energy levels.
ex.t: 很多人喜欢喝花草茶，因为它能对精力水平产生积极的影响。

ex.s: As a doctor, I know I had better change the way I eat, but I just don’t have the time or the energy right now.
ex.t: 作为一名医生，我知道我最好改变我的饮食方式，但我现在就是没有时间也没有精力。

ex.s: No one will ever know what mix of talent, ambition, energy and luck made Dickens such a singular writer.
ex.t: 无人能知，是天赋、抱负、精力与运气的何种组合造就了如此独特的狄更斯。

defs.def: the physical and mental effort that you use to do sth 精力；力量

ex.s: The increase of energy will even make you more willing to exercise, and that will raise your overall energy even more.
ex.t: 精力的增加甚至会让你更愿意锻炼，而这会进一步提高你的整体精力水平。

ex.s: When we turn on a light or switch on a TV or a computer we use energy and we need water to produce this energy.
ex.t: 事实是我们很幸运无论何时想要都有干净的水，但这对于世界上许多人来说并非如此。

defs.def: a source of power, such as fuel, used for driving machines, providing heat, etc. 能源

ex.s: What does Wipke suggest regarding energy transition?
ex.t: 关于能源转型，Wipke建议了什么？

ex.s: Glowing plants could reduce this distance and therefore help save energy.
ex.t: 发光植物可以缩短这一距离，从而有助于节省能源。

ex.s: They might help reduce energy consumption.
ex.t: 它们可能有助于减少能源消耗。

ex.s: There are energy savings to be made from all recyclable materials, sometimes huge savings.
ex.t: 利用所有可回收材料可以节省能源，有时可以节省大量资源。

ex.s: To ensure the supply of energy.
ex.t: 确保能源供应。

ex.s: That’s bad news for the environment — and our wallets — as these outdated devices consume much more energy than the newer ones that do the same things.
ex.t: 对环境来说这是个坏消息——对我们的钱包也是如此——因为这些过时的设备比做同样事情的新设备消耗更多的能源。

ex.s: But the most sensible form of adaptation is surely to adapt our energy systems to emit less carbon pollution.
ex.t: 但最明智的适应方式无疑是调整我们的能源系统以减少碳排放。

ex.s: Optimizing the use of energy.
ex.t: 优化能源的使用。

ex.s: This method provided a readout for how home energy use has evolved since the early 1990s.
ex.t: 这种方法提供了自1990年代初以来家庭能源使用情况的读数。

ex.s: And because the process of recycling steel is less polluting than making new steel, we’ve also achieved the following significant savings; in energy use—47% to 74%; in air pollution—85%; in water pollution—35%; in water use—40%.
ex.t: 而且因为回收钢比制造新钢污染更少，我们还取得了以下显著节约：能源使用——47%到74%；空气污染——85%；水污染——35%；用水——40%。

ex.s: “We need to speed up the development of green energy, and it will all get used,” says Wipke.
ex.t: Wipke说：“我们需要加快绿色能源的发展，而它都会被用上。”

ex.s: By providing long-distance communication and energy, electricity created the modem world.
ex.t: 通过提供远距离通信和能源，电力创造了现代世界。

ex.s: Barcelona has put together a package of clean energy technologies to help public transportation go greener, while also doing its part to tackle climate change and aid Europe’s difficult shift to the privately owned electric vehicle market.
ex.t: 巴塞罗那已经汇集了一整套清洁能源技术，以帮助公共交通走向绿色，同时也在应对气候变化并帮助欧洲艰难地转向私人拥有的电动车辆市场方面尽了自己的职责。

ex.s: The less energy you use, the less carbon dioxide is released.
ex.t: 你用的能源越少，释放的二氧化碳就越少。

defs.def: the ability of matter or radiation to work because of its mass, movement, electric charge, etc. 能；能量

ex.s: The decline in the demand for solar energy.
ex.t: 太阳能需求的下降。

ex.s: Solar Energy: Hope for the Future
ex.t: 太阳能：未来的希望

ex.s: We all need to get involved in saving energy                  it's at work, at home, or at school.
ex.t: 我们所有人都需要在节能中参与进来——无论是在工作、家里还是学校。

ex.s: They will speed up energy production.
ex.t: 它们可能向家庭传输电力。

ex.s: Which of the following uses the least energy?
ex.t: 以下哪种设备耗能最少？

ex.s: Among the bag makers' argument: many cities with bans still allow shoppers to purchase paper bags, which are easily recycled but require more energy to produce and transport.
ex.t: 在塑料袋生产商的说法中还提到：许多实施禁令的城市仍允许购物者购买纸袋，纸袋易于回收，但生产和运输耗能更多。

ex.s: However, longer-lasting reusable bags often require more energy to make.
ex.t: 一项研究发现，一个棉布袋必须至少使用131次才能比塑料袋更有利于环境。

ex.s: But all of that growth will take up a lot of space, and though more and more people accept the concept of solar energy, few like large solar panels to be installed near them.
ex.t: 但所有这些增长都会占用大量空间，而且尽管越来越多的人接受太阳能的概念，却很少有人喜欢附近安装大型太阳能板。

ex.s: Best of all, humor raises your energy, and that can have an effect on everything you do at school, at work, or in your personal life.
ex.t: 最好的是，幽默可以提高你的能量，这可以影响你在学校，工作或个人生活中所做的一切。

ex.s: They found that more on-demand entertainment viewing on tablets instead of TVs and desktop computers could cut energy consumption by 44%.
ex.t: 他们发现，更多在平板电脑上而不是电视和台式电脑上进行按需娱乐观看可以将能耗降低44%。

ex.s: Promote the use of solar energy in rural areas.
ex.t: 促进太阳能在农村地区的使用。

ex.s: “And if it is from energy from the trains’ brakes, then even better.”
ex.t: “如果用的是列车刹车产生的能量，那就更好了。”

ex.s: It uses reclaimed energy creatively.
ex.t: 它创造性地利用了回收的能量。

ex.s: It was a form of energy, giving me back something I’d lost.
ex.t: 那是一种能量，让我找回了失去的东西。

ex.s: Although exhausting, it gave me energy, enthusiasm and happiness.
ex.t: 尽管那件事令人筋疲力尽，它却给了我能量、热情和快乐。

ex.s: Whether I'm at the gym or on the road, my nervous energy pushes me through mile one.
ex.t: 无论是在健身房还是在路上，我那紧张的能量都推着我跑完第一英里。

ex.s: They consist of an electric motor which collects energy used in the braking action that would be lost as heat by conventional brakes.
ex.t: 它们由一个电动机构成，该电机收集制动过程中原本会被传统刹车以热量形式耗散的能量。

ex.s: To calculate the energy needed to power e-planes.
ex.t: 计算驱动电动飞机所需的能量。

ex.s: Little do they know that as they do so, a burst of energy is sent up to street level to help charge an electric car.
ex.t: 他们几乎不知道，在这么做的同时，一股能量被传送到街道层面，用来给一辆电动汽车充电。

ex.s: Alvaro Luna, a professor of electrical engineering, said that the system is innovative in so far as it allows for recycled energy to be redirected to specific local uses — in this case powering electric cars parked nearby.
ex.t: 电气工程教授Alvaro Luna表示，该系统的创新之处在于它能让回收的能量转向特定的本地用途——在这里就是为停在附近的电动汽车供电。
